cost_convention: Percentage-point subtraction from full starting capacity, not a percentage of the current remainder.

scenarios.title: Landing system malfunction
scenarios.prompt: You are approaching the Moon to land at Fra Mauro. A landing-system warning is flashing.

choices.label: Ask Mission Control to check the problem.
Wait and check the system again.
choices.outcome: The warning remains; Mission Control resolves it after a longer delay.

choices.label: Stop the landing to keep everyone safe.
choices.outcome: The landing is aborted and the crew is safe.

scenarios.title: Landing radar problem
scenarios.prompt: Descent has started, but the landing radar is not providing a reliable height.

choices.label: Check the radar settings and try again.
choices.outcome: The radar works again after troubleshooting.

choices.label: Use the backup height sensor.
choices.outcome: The backup sensor shows your height, but it uses extra power.

choices.label: Look through the window for a safe place.
choices.outcome: The surface is visible, but accurate height is unavailable.

scenarios.title: Final landing
scenarios.prompt: Large rocks occupy the landing area, and fuel is running low.

choices.label: Use landing lights to see the rocks better.
choices.outcome: The lights improve visibility and use power; a landing-site decision is still needed.

choices.label: Land between the rocks to save fuel.
choices.outcome: The landing is dangerously close to rocks.

choices.label: Fly to a clear area farther away.
choices.outcome: A clear landing area is reached using more fuel.

ending_thresholds.normal: Safe landing without every secret-ending condition.
ending_thresholds.bad: Resource exhaustion or an unsafe attempt, as defined by game logic.
ending_thresholds.safe: Scenario 1 choice C: abort the landing.

policy_decisions_required: Define which actions set safe_landing, safe_decisions and unsafe_attempt.
Scenario 1 B also continues after Mission Control fixes the problem.
Scenario 3 A improves visibility but does not itself select a landing site; let the player make a subsequent landing decision without repeatedly charging for already-enabled lights.

game_rules.final_lights_followup_costs: Choosing B or C after enabling lights charges that subsequent choice as well.
